revision: S3/P4 (user, 2026-11-06): 10HP re-layout. Top row MIDI, AUDIO, CV jacks; DETUNE/MIX and ATTACK/RELEASE on the outer columns (X10.25 / X40.25, centre +/-15 mm); ATTACK/RELEASE 4 mm lower (Y50.5) so DETUNE/MIX are easier to reach, vactrols follow them; LED column, MODE and REC buttons kept (re-centred +5.1 mm); REC button at the left edge with its REC LED to its right, between it and MODE (user swap, 2026-11-06; the lower ATTACK pot needs the old LED spot); FREQ centred; RES/CURVE on the DETUNE/ATTACK and MIX/RELEASE columns (X10.25 / X40.25, user 2026-11-06) with J10 moved up beside FREQ; bottom row LP / HP / BP / ENV OUT. Earlier history: research.md 4.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer A-100 10HP: 50.5 mm wide; holes at X12.58 and X43.06 (= Doepfer X7.5 + 1 HP and + 7 HP), 6 HP apart on the 2HP case grid (as the 8HP X12.58 / X32.9). Skiff rails as modules/low: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 49.5 x 110.0 mm, 0.5 mm inside the 50.5 mm panel each side and 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end (as modules/low); held by the seven jack nuts (RV09 pots take no nut). 4 layers (R1). 1 mm board-edge keep-out (root AGENTS.md): every courtyard >= 1.0 mm from the outline.

panel_order: Top to bottom (user P4, 2026-11-06): MIDI, AUDIO, CV jacks; DETUNE + MIX; ATTACK + RELEASE with the ASR/AR/HR LED column between them; REC button (left) + REC LED, MODE button (centre); FREQ; RES + CURVE (outer columns), J10 power header on B beside FREQ; LP / HP / BP / ENV OUT.
layout_note: 10HP leaves 47.5 mm between the 1 mm edge keep-outs. An RV09 courtyard is 12.92 mm wide (shaft -6.46 / +6.46). The outer pot columns (DETUNE/ATTACK/RES and MIX/RELEASE/CURVE) sit at the panel centre +/-15 mm; J10 sits on the right edge between RELEASE and CURVE.
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N (user stock 50k / 1M linear), vertical snap-in, no bushing, no nut, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint (as modules/low)
led_note: 3 mm THT on F at rotation 0 (pads side by side, anode pad 2 on the right), placed by the pad centre = body centre; dome flush with the panel front as modules/8bit (model Z +3.3).
button_note: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact (7 mm), stock SW_PUSH_6mm_H7.3mm on F, placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre, rot 180 (pad 1 signal on the bottom row) as modules/8bit; pressed through the panel by the modules/8bit printed cap (panels/button-actuator).

stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit (LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front).

vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint + modules/low courtyard. Mounted on B (hand-soldered, leads soldered on F), as modules/low and modules/vca-mix.

vactrols.note: SVF integrator 1 (HP -> BP) under the ATTACK (RV3) pot on B, between the lug row and the pin row (R1 pattern, user-approved 2026-10-22), moved with the pot: LED pads (1, 2) toward the centre, LDR pads (3, 4) toward the board edge.

SVF integrator 2 (BP -> LP) under the RELEASE (RV4) pot on B, between the lug row and the pin row (R1 pattern, user-approved 2026-10-22), moved with the pot: LED pads (1, 2) toward the centre, LDR pads (3, 4) toward the board edge.

power_header.orientation: Vertical at the right edge (user placement S2): rot 180 on B, pin 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom row Y82.0, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top row Y71.84, odd pins in the left column.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board. B-side parts placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.
power_header.edge_note: P4: right edge (outer pads 2.0 mm, courtyard 1.02 mm from it); moved 16.46 mm up (user, 2026-11-06) so CURVE can sit on the RELEASE column: courtyard Y70.02..83.81 between RELEASE/U7 (Y60.03) and CURVE (Y86.16); IDC16 envelope Y60.41..85.81 clears the U7 vactrol.

back_side_tht.note: right edge between RELEASE and CURVE, vertical, pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom (P4: moved up 16.46 mm for CURVE on the RELEASE column)
UPDI (pin 1 UPDI at Y12.4, pin 2 GND at Y14.94), on B, vertical in the top-right corner beside the CV jack

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).

vactrol_note: Both SVF vactrols sit on B under ATTACK / RELEASE (R1, user-approved 2026-10-22: 22 stacking DRC findings excluded by tools/vactrol_exclusions.py), 4.1 mm below the pot shaft.
jack_note: Jacks placed by the footprint origin = barrel = panel hole, all at rot 0 (P4: ENV OUT joins the bottom row).
